description: Synthetic English product-management interview; detailed (STAR) answer length. All names, companies, and metrics are invented.

candidate.name: Sana Whitfield
candidate.profile: Product manager for eight years at Orchard Lane Software, focused on onboarding and growth.

jobOffer.title: Lead Product Manager

evidence.evidence: Ran 40 customer interviews to redesign the onboarding flow
